# The range is A1:A11. In pandas, this is index 0 to 10 in column 0.
dates_series = pd.to_datetime(df.iloc[0:11, 0])

# 2. Compute
# The instruction asks for the "number of the last day" from the range.
# "Ensuring that the last date corresponds to the final entry if the dates are not sequential."
# This implies we should take the date from the last cell in the range (A11), 
# and extract the "number of the day" (the day of the month).

# Extract the day number
last_day_number = last_date_val.day

print(f"Dates range: {dates_series.tolist()}")
print(f"Last date in range: {last_date_val}")
print(f"Extracted day number: {last_day_number}")

# 3. Write
# Use openpyxl to modify only cell B1
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb.active # Assuming Sheet1 is the active sheet

# B1 is row 1, column 2
ws['B1'] = last_day_number

# 4. Verify & Audit
# - Literal Value: last_day_number is an int.
# - Precision: Written as int.
# - Minimal Mutation: Only B1 is changed.
# - Coverage: B1 is populated.

# Save the workbook
import os
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
